title: Sufficient conditions for multiplicity and uniqueness of positive solutions of the Hénon equation
summary: We establish explicit sufficient conditions for multiplicity of positive solutions of the Hénon equation in the unit ball and for uniqueness in one dimension. In the Sobolev-subcritical range, a spherical harmonic function argument shows that the radial solution has Morse index greater than one and therefore differs from a ground state. In even dimensions, a degree-four perturbation in a symmetry and monotonicity cone yields a sufficient condition for nonradiality in the supercritical range. The one-dimensional uniqueness criterion follows from a comparison of weighted Dirichlet eigenvalues…
